name: calendula officinalis flowering top + olea europaea (olive) leaf powder + pulsatilla pratensis whole + sodium borate
purpose: Purpose For symptoms of intimate irritation; for symptoms of burning and discomfort; for symptoms of intimate discomfort.
uses: Uses For the temporary relief of symptoms associated with: minor intimate irritation; minor burning, itching, and discomfort; intimate odor.
otcwarn: Warnings For vaginal use only. For adult use only. Do not use : if you are pregnant or breastfeeding, unless directed by a doctor if you have pelvic pain, fever, chills, or abnormal vaginal bleeding if you have unusual discharge with a foul odor if you have never had vaginal symptoms before if you are allergic to any ingredient in this product if the foil packet is damaged, torn, or previously opened Ask a doctor before use if you have : diabetes, a weakened immune system, or recurrent vaginal infections a serious medical condition or are under medical supervision symptoms that have lasted more than 7 days before starting use. When using this product : you may experience mild irritation at the application site. do not use tampons, douches, spermicides, or other vaginal products; this product may damage condoms and diaphragms and reduce their effectiveness. avoid contact with eyes. Stop use and ask a doctor if : symptoms do not improve within 3 days symptoms last more than 7 days symptoms worsen or return after completion new symptoms develop, including fever, pelvic pain, nausea, or unusual bleeding severe burning, swelling, or rash occurs at the application site. If pregnant or breastfeeding , ask a healthcare professional before use. Keep out of reach of children . If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away (1-800-222-1222).
